data.name: Harbir
data.gender_notes: Harbir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Har (God) + Bir (Light): Harbir represents the divine light that guides and protects us. In Hindu mythology, Harbir is a form of Lord Vishnu and is believed to bestow wisdom and courage upon his devotees. The name Harbir carries the meaning “God's Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harbir usually hope their child will grow to embody god's light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrier of divine light and wisdom.
data.etymology: Harbir belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harbir total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: Harbir is a well-known name in various Hindu communities. It reflects the deep admiration and beliefs in their divine deities. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu, one of the major gods, is considered the preserver of the universe and the bestower of wisdom, courage, and prosperity. The name Harbir is a sign of devotion and reverence for this god, who is believed to protect and guide His devotees on their spiritual and worldly journey.
data.spiritual_significance: Harbir, as a name, carries with it the spiritual meaning of the divine presence of God as light. It signifies the inner and outer guidance and protection granted by the Lord. The name is a constant reminder of the truth that God is the source of all wisdom, strength, and prosperity. Devotees who are named Harbir or adopt Harbir as a spiritual name seek to embody the qualities of wisdom, courage, and protection to radiate a guiding light to others in their lives and communities.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Harbir: Radiating with God's light and love. Bringer of joy and prosperity.
